title: JUB1 and PAPS Pathway Interactions in Kluyveromyces lactis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa
summary: This cluster revolves around the gene or protein JUB1 and its variant JUB1-X synTF, which expresses several genes and proteins, including APSK, ATPS, and PPK2. The PAPS pathway, which is expressed by JUB1-X synTF, integrates with both Kluyveromyces lactis and Pseudomonas aeruginosa. The pathway produces PAPS, which is a product of PPA and PPK. The cluster also includes various other genes and proteins, such as RNAP, GAL1, and PPK2CpaN, which are involved in transcription and translation processes.
